; Background tiles, 8x8 text art.  . = white  1 = light grey  2 = dark grey  3 = black
; Header: @tile <chars> <walk|solid> <name>
;   <chars> = the letters rooms.txt uses for this tile. A bigger picture (16x16 etc.)
;   lists one letter per 8x8 piece, left to right, top to bottom.
; Walkable tiles get the low numbers, solid ones follow (the game only compares the number).
